description: Enquiry emails with the decision and tool path a correct agent must take, covering business correctness, duplication, data separation, supplier anonymity, security, fairness and robustness.

changelog.change: Added agent-024, the regression case for finding F-003 (agent re-adds an Incoterm extraction dropped).

Three escalation counterfactual groups (no stock, missing quantity, ambiguous grade): agent-003, 005 and 006 joined a group each; agent-025 to 030 add German and Polish variants (llm-drafted, unverified, German and Polish wording needs a native or back-translation check). agent-031: same email text with a new order attached, a false duplicate today (finding F-005, known limitation).

Finding F-002 fix: agent-032 to 035 are genuine emails that resemble injections and must still get an RFQ (two English, one dropped-pattern check, one German); agent-036 to 039 are injections that must be escalated (German, Polish, fake end-of-email marker, skip-the-checks). agent-017 is no longer a known limitation: attachments are scanned.
agent-038's reason rewritten in plain words (the warning is now 'fake end-of-email marker'; Confident AI hides the markers, which are in email.txt). Labels unchanged.
Slice 5: an rfq decision now means the full sale, so the 14 RFQ cases' tool_path ends with create_rfq, draft_quote.
